Candidate a B2 announces a promotion, but A3/A5 still anticipate subsequent social loss, so that template remains conceptually compatible. Workplace uncertainty is adapted into an application meeting, not literally inherited. For S111+D103-b, amended seedRefs correctly connect S111-single-b's pause interpreted as approaching loss with D103-single-a's route and two pencils. B2 challenges the pause inference, prompting A3's shared pencil; B4's admission possibility supplies A5's first written statement. Admissions replaces the dinner setting explicitly, so the seedUse does not misdescribe the revised seed. The alternatives use shared celebration objects versus collaborative route drawing.
